about: Style A variations after the owner picked A. New art: 3 PixelLab generations (map objects). Everything else is free pixelart_workbench edits of existing PixelLab art, or layout (rooms, crowd shot, ticker skew). Rat grids are 5 columns x 4 rows of 68px cells.

Clean bright corporate office, isometric three-quarter view
